caption: The drawing depicts a hand fan comprised of a rectangular, slightly rounded panel attached to a turned wooden handle. The panel is decorated with an embroidered design featuring large, vivid red flowers with varying shades of pink and red petals, as well as smaller pinkish flowers. Green leaves of different shapes and sizes accompany the flowers, with accents of red berries and leafy stems filling the background. The background of the panel is black, which contrasts with the bright colors of the floral and foliage elements. The wooden handle is brown with a polished appearance, featuring rounded, symmetrical details along its length. The fan is positioned diagonally against a plain, light-colored background, and a faint shadow is visible to the left of the fan, indicating a light source from the right.
title: Fan
